tests.name: ordinary supervised graceful stop clears exact admission
tests.procedure: Start the actual KeyOwnerSupervisor with an isolated locally registered atom name, a valid manifest whose bound profile is disabled, and valid OTP CA DER. Capture exact owner/workers/table/epoch. Acquire and release a permit without starting a fetch. Supervisor.stop(component, :normal).
assertions: Parent shutdown invokes real owner cleanup without GenServer.stop(owner) or direct Admission erasure.
Exact owner and worker-supervisor PIDs stop; ETS.info(old_table) is undefined; exact persistent_term key is absent.
Admission.acquire and ConfiguredVerifier.authenticate reject with identity_unavailable. No flight/socket is created.

tests.name: explicit terminate child and restart fence old state
tests.procedure: Start ordinary component, acquire permit and capture old owner/table/epoch. Use Supervisor.terminate_child(component, KeyOwner), then Supervisor.restart_child(component, KeyOwner). For the finish rejection, construct only a stale Lease value from the captured old permit/epoch with placeholder snapshot fields; this is an early-fence rejection assertion and claims no authenticated lease acquisition.
assertions: After child termination, old table is gone and pointer absent; workers remain alive.
Restart returns a new owner PID/table/epoch with snapshots/attempts/flights/waiters/admitted/negatives empty.
An old permit is rejected by checkout and finish on replacement; releasing it is harmless and does not consume/delete a new permit.
No fixture success identity or verifier collaborator is injected.

tests.name: forced owner death denies during restart barrier
tests.procedure: Start ordinary component and record exact owner/workers/table/epoch. Suspend only the owned component supervisor in a try/after, kill only the owned owner, await old owner DOWN, inspect old pointer/table and call public denial. Resume owned supervisor in after and await replacement.
assertions: Old table is destroyed while old pointer may equal old_table; public acquire/authenticate return identity_unavailable without exception.
Resuming supervisor replaces workers and owner; new table/epoch and empty state appear; stale permit rejects; a synthetic stale Lease is used only to assert early-fence rejection.
Normal final component shutdown removes its current pointer. No global term erase, unrelated process action, or socket use occurs.

tests.name: close requires creator and current exact table
tests.procedure: In isolated test-owned processes use the actual Admission API to create old/current tables under a test-only key. Exercise guarded close with mismatched table, nonowner caller, absent key, already dead table, and then current owner/current table. Reap only exact fixture PIDs.
assertions: Mismatch, foreign caller, absent and dead-table attempts return false without changing a live current pointer.
Exact current-table creator close returns true once and false thereafter.
Expected-table checking is documented as serialized ordinary-lifecycle protection, not concurrent CAS.

tests.name: duplicate registered start cannot replace first owner
tests.procedure: While ordinary atom owner is alive, attempt a second ordinary KeyOwner.start_link with the same registered name and valid options; capture table before and after.
assertions: Second start returns already_started pointing to original PID and never publishes a new table.
First pointer/table/epoch are unchanged and still owned by original PID.
Original normal supervisor stop clears only that owner pointer.

tests.name: invalid start publishes no registry state
tests.procedure: Attempt ordinary supervised start with invalid manifest/binding/roots using isolated names; inspect exact component registrations and persistent_term key afterward.
assertions: Initialization fails with existing invalid_identity_configuration result.
No owner table is published; owned worker child is retired by failed supervisor startup.
No provider fetch or network fixture starts.

tests.name: worker supervisor failure preserves fail-closed restart
tests.procedure: Start actual ordinary component with disabled bound profile and no flights. Kill only its exact owned worker supervisor, await one_for_all replacement of both child PIDs, then stop normally.
assertions: Old KeyOwner follows parent shutdown despite trap_exit and catch-all handle_info; no old owner remains.
Any terminate callback exit is retained as failure evidence; do not hide it with a broad rescue.
New owner starts empty with new table/epoch; old permit rejects; final current pointer absent.
If cleanup faults, classify and narrow a follow-up before claiming this fault gate passed.
No-flight case does not exercise terminate_child against an already-dead worker supervisor; KOL09 covers that separate fault gate.

tests.name: real refresh drain under supervised stop and crash
tests.procedure: Separately adapt existing K07g/K07h assertions to actual ordinary KeyOwnerSupervisor and its real FetchFlight path with an explicitly authorized isolated synthetic TLS fixture. Pause exact owned TLS controller, request parent stop/restart, inspect resource barriers, resume in after, await complete cleanup.
assertions: Graceful admission closes before waiter failure/flight drain; stop cannot complete before exact controller/worker/raw-port DOWN.
Crash restart does not publish new owner until old supervised transport subtree stops.
Exact old PIDs and raw sockets are gone; no authority escapes via old lease/result.
Terminal counts and complete owned TLS/process cleanup are retained even on assertion failure.

tests.name: worker supervisor death while actual flights are tracked
tests.procedure: In a separately released synthetic TLS run, start a real refresh flight through ordinary KeyOwner and stop/kill only its exact owned DynamicSupervisor. Observe old owner shutdown, admission close, public waiter outcome, old resource PIDs/ports, and one_for_all replacement. Retain callback exception reports and full output.
assertions: Exact Admission key is closed by old owner even if later terminate_child targets an absent supervisor; pointer must not erase replacement.
Distinguish public safe_call denial from a waiter explicitly replied by terminate; neither alone proves flight or socket cleanup.
Record whether DynamicSupervisor.terminate_child exits after worker-supervisor death. Do not swallow or relabel callback faults as clean normal cleanup.
Require old owned flight/worker/controller/raw-port cleanup before accepting resource gate; if ordering/cleanup fails, propose a scoped follow-up before changing strategies or timeout policy.
